verdict.rationale: Buzz's own benchmark suite grades a 'reply-to-thread' behavior and scores 'where the reply lands', which implies the product supports thread replies attached to an original message. The only evidence comes from an agent-behavior benchmark, though, not from user-facing documentation of threading. missing for 10: first-party docs describing thread replies for human users and admins, CLI or protocol documentation of thread reply commands, and hands-on or independent corroboration of threaded side discussions.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: ten tasks including reply-to-thread, user-mention, create-channel-invite-users
what is graded is how the agent answers it through Buzz — where the reply lands, who it notifies, what it was willing to read
